title: Pipelines
overview_description: Pipelines let you transform and process messages coming from streams. Pipelines consist of stages where rules are evaluated and applied. Messages can go through one or more stages.
pipeline_details_description:
Pipelines let you transform and process messages coming from streams. Pipelines consist of stages where rules are evaluated and applied. Messages can go through one or more stages.
After each stage is completed, you can decide if messages matching all or one of the rules continue to the next stage.
rules_page_description: Rules are a way of applying changes to messages. A rule consists of a condition and a list of actions. The condition is evaluated against a message, and the actions are executed if the condition is satisfied.
rules_delete_confirm: Do you really want to delete rule "{{title}}"?
